rows.46:8b2c:
When I closed my eyes, I saw something white floating in the darkness.
It was that girl's mask.
The expressionless Noh mask that had been burned into my memory ever since, impossible to forget.
It hung there in the empty air, as if threatening me, or perhaps sneering at me.{p}
rows.46:8c0c:
At this rate, there was no way I'd ever get to sleep.
I gave up and opened my eyes.{p}
rows.46:8c5c:
The mask was floating above my head.
I caught my breath.
What is it doing here★
But my outstretched hand touched nothing.
A hallucination★
Had I been driven so far into a corner that I was seeing things?
The mask was still floating above my head.{p}
rows.46:8dec:
I opened my eyes.
The floating mask.
Had the mask possessed me?
Would I spend the rest of my life with this mask following me around?
Just the thought of it gave me goosebumps.{p}
rows.46:8ec8:
...Just then, a revelation came down from the heavens.
Of course. Why hadn't I thought of it before?
I just had to make myself blind.
Then, even if the mask was floating there, I wouldn't know.
As for when my eyes were closed, there was nothing to worry about.
Memories fade in time.
How brilliant was that?
I wanted to pat myself on the back.
No time like the present.
I was pretty sure there was a pair of scissors in my drawer.
Or would a compass work better?
Giggling to myself, I opened my desk drawer.{p}
rows.46:9144:
Believe it or not, I don't mind reading.
I flipped through the pages.
Just then, I thought I saw the letters move.
What?
I stopped and stared at the page.
It was a perfectly ordinary book.
Was it just my imagination...?
The moment I thought that and let out a sigh...{p}
rows.46:925c:
The page bulged up with a squish.
Caught in the movement, the print rippled.
What's happening★
I couldn't believe my eyes.
The page seemed to be trying to take the shape of a face.
It looked as if someone were pressing their face up from under the paper as a prank.
I can't believe this...
But the paper face twisted its lips into a crooked leer.
"Hyahahaha!"
An ugly laugh, as if it were mocking me.
I flew into a rage and hurled the book at the wall.
The book bounced off and landed on the floor, open to the same page again.
"Oh, come now. Don't you recognize me?"
The face in the book spoke.
"It's Arai. Have you forgotten me already?"
It was definitely Arai's voice.{p}
rows.46:9520:
"We've taken a liking to you, {a}. So we thought we'd stay with you."
A woman's voice came from right beside me.
The bedsheet had rumpled into the shape of a face.
This face, and that voice just now...
"I-Iwashita...?"
"That's right. From now on, we'll always be together."
"You show real promise, after all."
The curtain spoke.
That was Kazama!{p}
rows.46:9678:
I looked all around the room.
Was that Hosoda in the wallpaper?
Then was that Fukuzawa, there in the wood grain of the desk?
And in the uniform hanging on the hanger...
"Don't tell me you forgot about me. Makoto Shindo."{p}
rows.46:9748:
Oh my God.
What has happened to my room★{p}
rows.46:9790:
"Don't make such a pathetic face."
"Let's all get along, shall we?"
"We'll always be watching over you."
"That's right, forever."
"Even after you grow up."
"Even when you meet someone and get married."
"Even when you have a child and you're working for that child's sake."
"Even when you grow old someday and your children leave the nest."
"That's right, until the day you die."
"We'll be together forever."
"We'll watch over you."
"We'll watch over you."
"We'll always be watching over you."{p}
rows.46:9924: I covered my ears with both hands.{p}
rows.46:9950:
"Stop iiiiiit☆"
Even so, the faces in the room wouldn't shut up.{p}
rows.46:99b0:
"We like you, you know."
"And you like us too, right?"
"We told you the seven wonders, didn't we?"
"You're never alone. Not ever."
"Aren't you happy? Come on, you're happy, right?"
"When you go out, we'll hide in the wrinkles of your clothes."
"We can hide in the toes of your shoes, or even in your hair."{p}
rows.46:9ac4:
"Shut up! Shut up☆ If you don't shut up..."
There was a pounding on the door.
They must have heard me yelling.
My family came into the room.{p}
rows.46:9c3c:
Who am I talking to?
Can't they see the six of them★{p}
rows.46:9c74:
"Looks like these people can't see us. How fuuun."
"Let's tag along with them, let's tag along!"{p}
rows.46:9cd8:
"Stoooop☆"
I tried to shake off the hands gripping my arms.
"{b}☆"
"Pull yourself together☆"{p}
rows.46:9ddc:
The moment I screamed, something slammed into my head with a thud.
My vision swam and warped.
Someone hit me...?
I blacked out.{p}
rows.46:9e64:
...When I woke up, I was lying in a clean bed.
My arms and legs were strapped down, and I couldn't move.
A man in a white coat was saying something.
A state of delirium... something about adolescence... I couldn't really follow it.
My family cried when they heard it, but that didn't bother me much either.
There was just one thing.
What the faces had said was true.
On the pure white ceiling, on the curtains, everywhere, there were faces.
They were all watching me.
That one must be Hosoda, and that one over there, Kazama.
It didn't feel so unpleasant anymore.
As long as they were here, I wouldn't get bored, even in this white room.
I gave the faces a smile.{p}
rows.46:a090: This must be a gift from the girl.{p}
rows.46:a0c8:
I tried lifting the mask.
It was lighter than I'd expected.{p}What could she want me to do with it?
rows.46:a130: She wants me to wear it
rows.46:a140: She wants me to burn it
rows.46:a1b4:
At the same moment, I felt dizzy for an instant.
And then everything I saw changed completely.{p}
rows.46:a218:
The scene I saw through the mask.
It was the old school building.
And not just that, it was that girls' restroom!
In front of me were people I had never seen before.
All talking at once, they tried to force me into a stall.
Is this the mask's memory?{p}
rows.46:a300:
I was scared.
And just as much, I hated them so much I could hardly stand it.
Why is this happening to me?
What did I ever do?
I hate them.
Scum like this don't even deserve to live!
Just then, my eyes stopped on one of their faces.
This man!
I know this one.{p}
rows.46:a408:
I flung the mask away.
I looked at the window.{p}
rows.46:a4a8:
I took the scissors out of the drawer.
A sharp pair of scissors with pointed tips.
With these, I should be able to kill a person, no problem.
"Die..."
I tried muttering it under my breath.
I started to feel like I could do it.
Courage welled up inside me.
I'll kill him!
I gripped the scissors tight.
This time, I'll try shouting it louder.
"Just die☆"
That's right, dying is all it takes!{p}
rows.46:a61c: Without a moment's hesitation, I slashed my own throat straight across.{p}
rows.46:a6f0:
I lit it with matches I'd brought from the kitchen.
The mask must have been bone-dry, because it went up in flames in no time.
The rising smoke vanished into the dark night sky.
Where was the girl now, I wondered.
And those six, too.
Their bodies had been in the old school building, but I had a feeling they were somewhere else.{p}
rows.46:a7f8:
...The mask burned away to nothing.
I stamped on the few scraps left to put out the embers, and decided to go back to my room.
rows.46:a8c0:
...It must be my imagination.
So much has happened, my nerves must be on edge.{p}
rows.46:a914: I shook my head and went back to my room.
rows.46:a950:
The moment I opened the door, a gust of wind hit me in the face.
That's strange. I was sure I'd shut the window.
I held down the flapping curtain and went to close the window.
And then.
Something that shouldn't have been there came into view.{p}
rows.46:aa24:
Something glowing faintly in the dark room.
Sitting all alone on the desk: that girl's white mask.
I stared at it, speechless.
Why did I ever think I could burn it?
There's no way I could burn this mask.
Even if I smashed it, or sank it in the sea, it would surely come back to me again.
The girl had been set free from the spell of the mask her own curse had created.
And now it was my turn.
There was no way to escape...
As I stood there in a daze, the mask grinned at me.{p}
rows.46:ac88:
I have to wake up.
Once I wake up, it'll be the same morning as always.
It has to be.
I have to wake up.
I have to wake up.
I have to wake up.
I have to wake up.
I have to wake up.{p}
rows.46:ad4c:
...Someone shook me roughly awake.
I looked around in a panic.{p}
rows.46:ada8:
This is... the newspaper club room!
Hino was looking at me, exasperated.{p}
rows.46:ae04:
"A first-year, and you nod off in the middle of a meeting?
You've got some nerve."
"I-I'm sorry..."
I stood up.
My face turned red on its own.
"It's fine. But in exchange, you'll be the one heading up our next project."
Hino laughed brightly.
He never acts high and mighty. He's a good senior.
But what next project?
"Um... what are we doing?"
Hino made a big show of answering my question.{p}
rows.46:af74: "We're doing a feature on this school's seven wonders. I've already rounded up the people who'll tell the stories."
rows.46:afd0:
It felt as if a heavy lump had been shoved into my stomach.
No... that's crazy.{p}
rows.46:b098:
Am I still dreaming?
In an endless night where dawn never comes...{p}

notes: 46:ad28: speaker is Hino (next rows); name moved inside the question for natural English.
